name: Himanshu Kumar
summary:
Dynamic Asset & Wealth Management professional with 8+ years of experience managing UHNI, Family Office, and Corporate
Treasury portfolios across India. Expertise in portfolio construction, asset allocation, investment advisory, FP&A, and financial
modelling, with a strong focus on risk-adjusted returns and long-term capital preservation. Proven ability to analyze market
dynamics, identify investment opportunities, and deliver actionable insights across equities, fixed income, and mutual fund
products. Successfully managed multi-crore client portfolios, enhanced reporting and analytics through automation and data-
driven dashboards, and partnered with cross-functional teams to drive strategic initiatives and business growth.
